Upstream is a React + Electron desktop Ludo with a lobby. GifOS cannot
inline that stack, so this directory is a classic-script rewrite of the
rules (six to leave the yard, 56 steps home, capture sends the other
token back, extra turn on a six). The board is generic Ludo — not a
branded product. Invite is the four seats; there is no lobby.

The notice travels INSIDE the GIF as well as beside it here.
